Things To Do This Weekend in San Antonio – August 28 – August 30, 2026

Posted by Maya Keith | Aug 27, 2026 | Announcements, Things to Do in San Antonio this Weekend | August 28-30

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 18:43
Instaread

Jump to: Free | Friday | Saturday | Sunday | Adults | Kids

The best Things to do in San Antonio this Weekend (August 28 – August 30) include PAWtitas Con Purpose, Boom Ball Tour, and more!

I’ve rounded up the top events and activities happening across the city—from festivals and outdoor fun to live shows and family-friendly picks. Scroll down for my picks — or use the links above to skip to your favorite section!

Weather this Weekend (August 28 – August 30): San Antonio will face intense late-August heat and thick, lingering cloud cover, accompanied by light winds and near-zero chances for rain.

Editor’s Note:  We update this guide each week with verified listings from trusted sources. Still, details can change — please confirm with the event organizer before heading out.

This post may contain affiliate links. If you click and make a purchase, we may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you.

We only recommend experiences we truly believe in! Curious how we choose these events? Here’s our process.

Check out our recent updates to the 100 Free & Cheap Activities for Kids in San Antonio, Things To Do with Teens in San Antonio, and Best Summer Camps in San Antonio.

Free Things to Do in San Antonio this Weekend

PAWtitas Con Purpose!

Celebrate the 12th annual Clear the Shelters campaign alongside Telemundo 60 San Antonio and the Animal Defense League of Texas at a fun-filled community day at the Paul Jolly Campus.

Discover local vendors, mingle with fellow animal lovers, and meet countless wagging tails and purring friends looking for a permanent home.

With adoption fees waived all month long for all pets, bring your family and friends to find your brand-new best friend and help clear the shelters together.

When: Saturday, August 29, 2026 | 12:00 PM – 3:00 PM
Where: Animal Defense League of Texas (Paul Jolly Campus), 210 Tuleta Dr. San Antonio, TX 78212
How Much: Free

Nourish Healing in Community Festival

Reconnect with yourself and explore holistic wellness during an inspiring afternoon where San Antonio’s premier holistic practitioners come together to share their gifts through affordable mini healing sessions.

Whether you are looking for massage therapy, reiki, advanced skincare, cupping, sound therapy, acupuncture, Access Bars, or general energy healing, you will find a welcoming community ready to support your nervous system and deep relaxation.

Come explore, connect, and pour back into your own spirit in a safe, nurturing environment.

When: Sunday, August 30, 2026 | 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM
Where: Nourish Healing Collective, 221 W Rhapsody Drive Ste 101 San Antonio, TX 78216
How Much: Free

Things to Do in San Antonio this Friday | Weekend Kickoff Events

Weather on Friday: Overcast to mostly cloudy and stiflingly warm, with a high of 102°F, a low of 77°F, and a 0% chance of precipitation.

It’s A 2000s Party

Throw it back to the ultimate Y2K decade as “It’s A 2000s Party” returns to Stable Hall at Pearl. Get ready for a high-energy dance party featuring non-stop hits, iconic throwbacks, and fan-favorite anthems spanning pop, hip-hop, indie, and rock from the turn of the millennium. Dust off your best Y2K fit, bring your crew, and dance the night away to the defining soundtrack of the 2000s.

When: Friday, August 28, 2026 | 8:00 PM
Where: Stable Hall, 307 Pearl Pkwy, San Antonio, TX 78215
How Much: Ticket prices vary – Buy Your Tickets Here!

Jesse Raub Jr. and Jenna Paulette

Experience a night of genuine Texas country music at historic Gruene Hall as powerhouse vocalists Jesse Raub Jr. and Jenna Paulette co-headline the stage. Known for his hard-hitting, working-class anthems and her traditional “cowgirl western” sound, this double-header showcases two of the Lone Star State’s most authentic country talents in Texas’ oldest continually operating dance hall.

When: Friday, August 28, 2026 | 7:45 PM
Where: Gruene Hall, 1281 Gruene Rd, New Braunfels, TX 78130
How Much: Ticket prices vary – Buy Your Tickets Here!

Class is in Session: Summer Movie Nights

Elevate your Friday nights high above the city at High Praise Rooftop Bar & Restaurant for a stellar outdoor film series where each week brings a fresh cinematic theme.

Catch unique weekly features starting at 8:45 PM, ranging from substitute teachers turning detention into rock history to harmless rumors earning students unexpected reputations.

Enjoy the downtown views, but note that outside food and beverages are not permitted, and screenings will move indoors in the event of rain.

When: Friday, August 28, 2026 | 8:45 PM – 10:45 PM
Where: High Praise Rooftop Bar & Restaurant, 111 East Pecan St San Antonio, TX 78205
How Much: Not stated

Gary Clark Jr. in concert

Image credit: Gary Clark Jr.

Catch acclaimed guitar virtuoso and modern blues powerhouse Gary Clark Jr. live in concert as he takes the historic Aztec Theatre stage.

Experience an explosive evening showcasing his signature genre-bending sound, incredible guitar mastery, and selections spanning his celebrated catalog, including tracks from his 2024 release, JPEG Raw.

When: Friday, August 28, 2026 | 7:00 PM
Where: Aztec Theatre, 104 S St Mary’s St, San Antonio, TX 78205
How Much: Starts at $92

Smithsonian Starstruck: An Immersive Experience

Step into a virtual reality adventure that places you directly inside the cosmos. Created in collaboration with the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory, this journey allows you to climb aboard powerful telescopes to uncover ancient mysteries, listen to the Sun’s vibrations, and behold solar flares 30 times the size of Earth.

You will also get to explore a volcanic exoplanet where diamonds glitter beneath the surface and venture to the very edge of a supermassive black hole as it consumes a star.

When: Friday, August 28 – September 27, 2026 | 10:00 AM
Where: Shops at Rivercenter, 849 E Commerce St, San Antonio, TX 78205
How Much: Starts at $20.40

AquaGlow at SeaWorld San Antonio Aquatica

Dive into an electrifying nighttime splash party where the fun truly shines. This family-friendly event transforms the park into a neon wonderland featuring glowing water slides, an immersive luminescent foam zone, and a lazy river that pulses with vibrant light as the sun sets.

When: Friday, August 28 – September 5, 2026 | 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM
Where: SeaWorld San Antonio, 10500 SeaWorld Dr, San Antonio, TX 78251
How Much: Starts at $29.99 – Buy Your Tickets Here!

Things to Do in San Antonio this Weekend | Top Picks Saturday

Weather on Saturday: Sizzling conditions under broken cloud cover with oppressive afternoon humidity, a high of 103°F, a low of 77°F, and a 0% chance of precipitation.

SKYROCKET! (18+ Event)

Get ready for a high-energy nostalgic throwback as premier cover band SKYROCKET! takes the stage at Sam’s Burger Joint. Renowned for their meticulous attention to detail and electrifying live shows, the group resurrects the ultimate hits of the 1970s and 1980s—from pop and new wave to classic rock anthems—turning the venue into a massive sing-along and dance party.

When: Saturday, August 29, 2026 | 8:30 PM
Where: Sam’s Burger Joint, 330 E Grayson St, San Antonio, TX 78215
How Much: Ticket prices vary – Buy Your Tickets Here!

Yoga Underground

Image credit: Natural Bridge Caverns

Experience ultimate relaxation deep inside an ancient, natural cavern 180 feet underground as instructor Winzer Van Delden leads a gentle, all-levels flow yoga class combined with an immersive sound bath.

Held in the breathtaking Ballroom of the Hidden Wonders Cavern, a naturally formed space featuring a large breakout dome and uniquely resonant acoustics, this intimate event offers a tranquil escape into nature’s wonder.

Because capacity is strictly limited to 65 participants, sessions sell out fast, so early registration is encouraged.

When: Saturday, August 29, 2026 | 8:30 AM – 10:00 AM
Where: Natural Bridge Caverns, 26495 Natural Bridge Caverns Rd, San Antonio, TX 78266
How Much: $44.99

Boom Ball Tour

Image credit: Boom Ball

Step up to an entirely reimagined ballpark experience with the high-energy Boom Ball Tour, a fast-paced interactive touring show blending athletic entertainment with massive spectacle.

Enjoy six quick-fire innings featuring trick plays, music, crowd participation, big personalities, a pre-game Boom Fest with player appearances, a stadium-wide light show, and a dazzling fireworks finale designed to thrill audiences of all ages.

When: Saturday, August 29, 2026 | 5:00 PM
Where: Nelson W. Wolff Municipal Stadium, 5757 US-90, San Antonio, TX 78227
How Much: Starts at $18.76

San Antonio Restaurant Weeks: Summer Edition

Celebrate the city’s ever-evolving culinary scene during a massive three-week dining showcase featuring specially curated prix-fixe lunch, brunch, and dinner menus at accessible price points across San Antonio.

Discover new culinary hot spots and revisit beloved local favorites as restaurants highlight the incredible diversity of local flavors.

When: Saturday, August 29, 2026
Where: Participating restaurants throughout San Antonio
How Much: Not stated

Dinosaurs in Motion

Operate levers, pulleys, and remote controls to bring 14 life-size kinetic dinosaur sculptures constructed from recycled metal to life. Then, head over to the on-site Innovation Stations to dive into hands-on art and science projects built for the whole family.

When: Saturday, August 29 – September 7, 2026 | 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Where: The DoSeum, 2800 Broadway, San Antonio, TX 78209
How Much: Included in admission

Things to Do in San Antonio this Weekend | Sunday Funday

Weather on Sunday: Blazing hot with scattered clouds and light southerly breezes, a high of 103°F, a low of 77°F, and a 4% chance of precipitation.

Café & Cuddles

Image credit: Once in a Wild

Spend a wild, relaxing Sunday afternoon with family and friends at Refuge Coffee + Beer Garden as Once in a Wild hosts an interactive community pop-up event.

Drop in for free to enjoy delicious coffee, craft beer, wine, and food while browsing local vendors and kids’ activities, or purchase encounter tickets to meet giant rabbits, tortoises, reptiles, and guinea pigs.

Zookeepers will be on-site all afternoon sharing fascinating animal facts and guiding safe, hands-on encounters with incredible species from their animal family.

When: Sunday, August 30, 2026 | 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM
Where: Refuge Coffee + Beer, 11011 Shaenfield Rd, San Antonio, TX 78254
How Much: $15

Positive Action Fitness Crawl

Imagine an energetic pub crawl, but instead of bars, you are exploring San Antonio’s best fitness spots on an approximately 4-mile social run through East Downtown and Broadway led by local run clubs.

Complete beginner-friendly, fun workouts at various fitness stops featuring everything from strength training and conditioning to cycling, Pilates, mobility, and recovery before finishing back at St. Paul Square to celebrate at the Juntos San Antonio Farmers Market.

A portion of the proceeds directly benefits Girls on the Run South Central Texas, combining community movement with a great cause.

When: Sunday, August 30, 2026 | 7:00 AM – 12:00 PM
Where: Positive Action Rehab and Performance, 1120 E Commerce San Antonio, TX 78205
How Much: $31

Zoorassic Park

Step back into the prehistoric era at the San Antonio Zoo to encounter life-sized, animatronic dinosaurs like the Tyrannosaurus Rex and the massive, long-necked Brachiosaurus.

This special exhibition blends wildlife conservation with ancient history, offering you rare photo opportunities alongside custom fossil displays.

When: Sunday, August 30 – September 7, 2026 | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Where: San Antonio Zoo, 3903 N St Mary’s St, San Antonio, TX 78212
How Much: Buy Your Tickets Here!
